description: Central Province - Amendment to the Order made under Sec. 20 of the Regulations of the Passenger Transport Service Authority Statute No. 01 of 2000 published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1990/48 of 29.10.2016 (E only)
reasoning: This gazette notification primarily concerns the amendment of legal/regulatory frameworks for passenger transport services in the Central Province. It references specific statutes (Passenger Transport Service Authority Statute No. 01 of 2000 and Route Passenger Transport Statute No. 04 of 1992) and outlines regulatory requirements for bus service operations, including technical specifications, financial management, and audit procedures. While it mentions a minister's name, this is incidental to the main purpose of publishing regulatory amendments rather than constituting a personnel appointment with detailed portfolio responsibilities.
